$comment: The studio's Cloudflare token for draft collaboration's edge: it keeps the Zero Trust list of collaborators equal to the active invitations, and ends a revoked collaborator's Access sessions (core/src/collab/access.ts). scripts/zero-trust-token.sh applies this file to the allthings account and stores the value in 1Password. Zero Trust Write is the narrowest group that writes Gateway lists; Access: Organizations Revoke only ends sessions. Grant nothing else.
name: allthings studio (Zero Trust list and sessions)
